translations.web: Behold, children are a heritage of Yahweh. The fruit of the womb is his reward.
translations.bsb: Children are indeed a heritage from the LORD, and the fruit of the womb is His reward.
translations.kjv: Lo, children are an heritage of the LORD: and the fruit of the womb is his reward.
translations.asv: Lo, children are a heritage of Jehovah; And the fruit of the womb is his reward.
